items.title: Return completed claim form and wildlife-damage certificate
items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: The letter is dated Sat 21.11.2026; the insurer is a private company, so no statutory 'deemed delivery' rule applies and the period runs from the letter's own date. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026. The letter defines 'Werktage' itself as Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting 13 such working days from 22.11.2026 (skipping Sundays 22.11., 29.11. and 06.12., and checking both NW and HE holiday calendars for this period — none fall in the window) lands on Monday 07.12.2026. The result Mon 07.12.2026 is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: This is a request from a private insurer, not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the 13-working-day period runs from the letter's own date, so if it actually arrived later than the day it was written, there is in practice less time than the nominal 13 working days — double-check the envelope's postmark if available.
The letter mentions an attached 'Schadenfragebogen' that was not included in the text provided; make sure you have that form and the Wildschadenbescheinigung ready before the deadline.
